limits: No target GT, scores, images, RGB masks, raw points, observation/feature caches or index sidecars decoded.
Physical A/B disjointness is a bound implementation contract and trace hash/count check; reducer does not reopen P to independently prove it.
Shared RGB/source q0/shape prior can preserve the same wrong evidence in both partitions; association_supported is geometric compatibility only.
Effective scores are primary; raw scores are pre-gate diagnostics. Defined conflict0 remains different from association-undefined NA.
Uniform means include defined conflict0, exclude inactive and undefined; active-face and RGB denominators are separate.
Exact-half ranking can retain NA to meet K; it is not the weighted-constraint failclosed rule.
Changed coordinates, stable evidence and converged loss do not establish task improvement.
